missed_dose.value:
FDA Label (SAVAYSA): If a dose is missed, take it as soon as possible on the same day and resume the normal dosing schedule the next day. Do not double the dose to make up for a missed dose.

EHRA 2021 Practical Guide (QD Regimen):
• Missed dose: Take the forgotten dose up until 12 hours after the scheduled intake (half of the 24-hour dosing interval). After 12 hours, skip the missed dose and take the next scheduled dose.
• Double dose: Continue the normal QD dosing regimen without skipping the next daily dose.
• Uncertainty about dose intake:
  - High thromboembolic risk (CHA2DS2-VASc >= 3): Take another tablet 6–8 hours after the original uncertain intake and continue the planned regimen.
  - Low thromboembolic risk (CHA2DS2-VASc <= 2): Wait until the next scheduled dose.
• Acute overdose (≤ 2 hours, no bleeding): Consider activated charcoal (30–50 g in adults) to reduce absorption.

refs.quote: If a dose of SAVAYSA is missed, the dose should be taken as soon as possible on the same day. Dosing should resume the next day according to the normal dosing schedule. The dose should not be doubled to make up for a missed dose.

For NOACs with a once daily (QD) dosing regimen, a forgotten dose can be taken up until 12h after the scheduled intake. After these time points, the dose should be skipped, and the next scheduled dose should be taken.
For NOACs with a QD dosing regimen, the patient should continue the normal dosing regimen, i.e. without skipping the next daily dose.

For NOACs with a QD dosing regimen, when thromboembolic risk is high (CHA2DS2-VASc >= 3), it may generally be advisable to take another tablet 6-8h after the original (uncertain) intake and then continue the planned dose regimen. In case the thromboembolic risk is low (CHA2DS2-VASc <= 2) we advise to wait until the next scheduled dose.

value.restart_timing: Resume 6–8h after immediate/complete hemostasis; for high bleeding-risk surgery, defer therapeutic NOAC >= 48–72h and consider prophylactic LMWH 6–8h post-op

value.restart_timing: Restart 6–8h after procedure as soon as adequate hemostasis has been established

refs.quote: SAVAYSA use during labor or delivery in women who are receiving neuraxial anesthesia may result in epidural or spinal hematomas. Consider use of a shorter acting anticoagulant as delivery approaches [see Warnings and Precautions (5.3) ] .
